help.title: How Nido works
help.write.title: Write it as you'd say it
help.write.body: "Take out the bins every Monday @{name}" repeats it every Monday and gives it to {name}. It also understands "tomorrow", "on Saturday" or "every 2 days".
help.write.bodyAlone: "Take out the bins every Monday" repeats it every Monday. It also understands "tomorrow", "on Saturday", "every 2 days" and, with @ and a name, who does it.
help.swipe.title: Swipe to tick off
help.swipe.body: Swipe a note to the right and it's done, with undo.
help.refresh.title: Pull the door
help.refresh.body: The door's handle, or pulling the list down, brings in the latest from your home.
help.quantity.title: Change the amount
help.quantity.body: Tap the quantity, on the right of each item, to add or take one away without leaving the list.
help.invite.title: Invite with a link
help.invite.body: In Settings, Invite makes a link; whoever opens it sees the home before joining.
help.magnets.title: Magnets are people
help.magnets.body: Everyone in the home has a magnet with their initial and colour, and the one on a note says whose it is. Tap a magnet on the door to see only theirs; "Everyone" shows everything.
help.tabs.title: Today and Tasks
help.tabs.body: Today is what is due today and what was left from earlier days. Tasks is everything in the home, by day: pick a day in the row of pills or look at "All".
help.earlier.title: From earlier days
help.earlier.body: What had a date and wasn't done. It doesn't expire or disappear: it stays in Today, no rush, until someone ticks it off.
help.assign.title: For someone else
help.assign.body: What you type in the field is yours. To give it to someone else, tap the + with the field empty and choose on the "Who" magnet, or type @ and their name.
help.shopping.title: The shopping is everyone's
help.shopping.body: What you add, everyone at home sees. Tick what you pick up and it goes to the bag; back home, empty the bag.
help.againDone: The tips will show again where they help.

license.complimentaryBody: Nido doesn't charge yet: this home has everything without paying. If that changes, each home will have its own monthly licence, paid by whoever runs it, and we'll tell you first.
license.transferNote: If you hand this home over, the licence stays with the home and whoever paid it keeps paying, until they cancel it or the person who runs the home takes it over.

help.households.body: You can be in more than one home, for example yours and your mother's. Each has its own tasks, shopping and people, and they don't mix. Switch home by tapping its name on the door or in Settings, under “Your homes”; this phone remembers which one you were in.
